title: Shared shopping with no lost edits
description: Adding and checking off items from different devices, keeping the changes when the connection drops for a while.

blocks.text: One person adds items at home, another checks them off at the shelf. The list shows not only the names but the state of the latest changes: what has been sent and what is still waiting for a connection.

quote.text: my husband and I can add items from anywhere, and the list updates instantly for both of us. No more duplicate buys or forgotten essentials.

blocks.text: Two participants and one shared list are enough to start with. What is needed is an undo for an accidental check-off and a clear resolution for the case where one person deleted an item while the other was changing its quantity.
How to test whether it helps

The critical test happens on a weak signal, not on an empty demo list. Reliable shared shopping may be the main value of the product; extra recipes do not make up for the milk that went missing or an item bought twice.
